name: 0xScope
rootCause: lmk.fun (formerly Scopescan) issued an alert on the X platform, warning that the X account of the Web3 knowledge graph protocol 0xScope (@ScopeProtocol) has been hacked. Users are advised not to click on any links or trust any content posted by the account. An investigation and recovery are currently in progress.
